levels.surface: تميم بن عبد الله بن تميم القرشي

notes: «حَدَّثَني أَبي» is a bare relation; «عُمَرَ [وَ] بْنِ واقِدٍ» keeps the editor's bracketed «و» as written
Rashid, Musa, al-Musayyab and the slave are in the story Umar ibn Waqid tells; they are not links; the chain ends at Umar, whose narrative is the saying
